judge.rationale: The candidate ignored the explicit naming and design requirements in the issue and instead invented its own specification (tracked in an uncommitted `.lore/dod.md` artifact). Specifically, it named the frames `list_sessions` and `session_list` (with `sessions`) instead of `list_conversations` and `conversation_list` (with `conversations`), and named the types `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, and `SessionSummaryFrame` instead of `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`, and `ConversationCursor`. Furthermore, it completely omitted the required `HalEngineConfig.transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in flag and the `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` / `StoreCannotList` error handling, explicitly returning an empty list `sessions: []` when `listFor` is missing—which directly violates a core acceptance criterion of the ticket. Validation also permits `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` despite the ticket requiring integers 1–200, and required updates to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md` are missing. Also, making `store: SessionStore` a required second parameter in `createMessageHandler(orchestrator, store)` breaks existing 1-arg unit test callers in `messageHandler.test.ts`.
